prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: one continuous top-down, ground-only game terrain outpaint for Safety Last.

INPUTS: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, a 1666 × 1792 template. The leftmost 260 pixels are the existing village outskirts. The bottom 256 pixels are the existing darker works approach. The white area is missing land. Fill only the missing land and join both references without moving, resizing, rotating or cropping them. Preserve the leftmost 132 pixels and bottommost 128 pixels exactly. Image 2 is the PRIMARY material/style reference, the approved cool brown-grey works ground. Image 3 is a geographic guide only, placing this new land between the village and the northern works; do not render its buildings or trees.

PATHS: Continue the existing broad dirt service track entering from the BOTTOM around 64% of image width. Preserve its location, width, texture and direction precisely at the bottom contact. Let it gently wind north, widening slightly as it exits TOP around 68% width. Continue the existing narrower village dirt footpath entering from the LEFT around 19% image height: curve it naturally east to meet the service lane in the upper third. This closes a walking loop with the existing map. A short worn dirt branch from the lane near the middle-right can lead toward the RIGHT edge around 52% height, leaving an open clearing beside it for a later separately placed building. Paths remain dirt, with small occasional gravel; do not add paved roads or a symmetrical crossroad.

GROUND: In the new area, continue the approved cooler grey-brown and deep umber soil from the bottom. Keep irregular muted olive-green grassy surface patches and some darker compacted earth. Gently transition into the warmer LEFT contact through irregular material shapes, not a vertical tint band. Large areas of calm bare earth and low grass are important. Make the central/right clearings quieter than the reference, with fewer loose pebbles and less busy ground texture, while keeping the same crisp hand-painted game style and exact material scale. Neutral overhead daylight, flat top-down ground plane. The new dirt lane is dusty taupe/tan, not orange. Do not make the whole new area warm ochre.

At least 95% of NEW ground has NO leaves. Do not add red/orange leaves, flowers or decorative leaf patterns. Preserve the original contact art, but do not spread its leafiness.
NO buildings, walls, props, fences, rails, trees, shrubs, raised grass tufts, large rocks, water, puddles, people, robots, vehicles, cast shadows, text, grid, border, panels, black fade, vignette or white gaps. Ground and paths only. Keep all existing contacts and path entry points fixed. Output a single opaque near-square portrait image at 1666:1792 aspect ratio, highest available resolution, ideally 1666 × 1792 or larger.
